agent_explanation: The state-feedback controller regulates pole angle (theta stays ~-0.05 to -0.08 rad, margin ~0.72) but applies only weak cart-correcting force (~0.26-0.58 N vs 45.6 N limit). Starting off-center (x=-0.45) with outward velocity (v=-0.24 m/s), the cart drifts monotonically negative (x=-1.09 at step 70, -1.53 at step 100, -2.38 at step 139) until it exits the track at step 140 (x=-2.40). Cause is insufficient cart-position authority/weighting in the balancing controller, not a disturbance (no pushes, no noise).
